collection.name: The Daily Tribune: A Farcaster Newspaper
collection.description: Daily curated newspaper for Farcaster. Each issue is a unique NFT capturing the top stories, trending casts, and channel highlights of that day.
collection.collectionImagePrompt: Classic newspaper front page banner in black and white ink style. Clean editorial broadsheet aesthetic, aged newsprint texture, dramatic and classic. Wide banner composition, no color, pure ink on paper.
